findings.evidence: In the PR, `exists_partialDiffeomorph_ball` takes `{F} ... (hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E = Module.finrank ℝ F)`. The ball iff instantiates it with `(F := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E))) (by simp)`; the proof does not otherwise depend on the Euclidean model.
findings.fix: Add `{F} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [InnerProductSpace ℝ F] [FiniteDimensional ℝ F] (hdim : finrank ℝ E = finrank ℝ F)`, state the result for `PartialDiffeomorph I 𝓘(ℝ, F) M F ∞`, and pass `hdim` where the proof now uses `(by simp)`.
findings.issue: `isLocallyConformallyFlat_iff_forall_exists_partialDiffeomorph_ball` fixes the target to `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (Module.finrank ℝ E))`. Both lemmas it uses (`exists_partialDiffeomorph_ball`, `isLocallyConformallyFlat_of_forall_exists_partialDiffeomorph`) and the sibling iff `isLocallyConformallyFlat_iff_forall_exists_partialDiffeomorph` take an arbitrary finite-dimensional inner-product space `F`.

findings.evidence: Both proofs use `simpa only [mfderiv_id, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply] using tangentSpaceOpenEquiv_mfderiv_apply (I' := I) (f := Opens.inclusion _) (A := id) rfl _`. Restriction.lean:76 has only `IsLocalRiemannianIsometry.subtype_val`.
findings.fix: Make it a public lemma next to `IsLocalRiemannianIsometry.subtype_val` in `Riemannian/Isometry/Restriction.lean`, and use it in both Solvability.lean and Chart.lean.
findings.issue: `isLocalRiemannianIsometry_opens_inclusion` (nested `Opens.inclusion` is a local Riemannian isometry and commutes with `tangentSpaceOpenEquiv`) is a general fact but is private here. Chart.lean re-proves the same step inside `isLocalRiemannianIsometry_rescale_opens` (the `hteq` block).

summary: The ball-chart characterization fixes the target to `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)` even though the lemmas it is built from accept any inner-product space `F` of the right dimension. A general open-inclusion isometry lemma is private in one file and re-proved inline in another.
